Furesø is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, with a specific focus on Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation therapy [^src1]. 

Furesø's data is derived from the DanStroke database and is presented alongside statistics for all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. This detailed municipal breakdown serves as a vital tool for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. The specific metrics for Furesø, including patient counts and stroke events, are documented in a tabular format on page 93 of the report [^src1]. Because the available evidence consists of a single tabular mention, further narrative details, historical context, or longitudinal trends regarding Furesø's specific clinical outcomes are not elaborated upon in this section of the corpus.
